name: ARCTURUS DEFENSE Warbrace Mk-IV Assault Arm
product_name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Warbrace Mark IV Assault Arm
description:
The Warbrace Mk-IV is a full arm replacement built around a titanium-alloy endoskeleton with integrated subdermal blade housing along the forearm, capable of deploying a 22cm ceramic-composite blade in 0.3 seconds. Recoil-dampening hydraulic buffers in the shoulder joint absorb up to 800N of force, allowing the arm to stabilize heavy weapons or absorb blunt trauma without joint failure. Striking surfaces on the knuckle plates are reinforced with tungsten carbide inserts rated for repeated impact against ballistic materials.

The Warbrace Mk-IV is standard-issue among Meridian 88 private military contractors and black-market enforcement crews who need a limb that doubles as a weapon platform. Distribution is tightly controlled through Arcturus's licensed dealer network, but units regularly surface in Tier 2 black markets after battlefield salvage. Owning one without military credentials draws immediate law enforcement scrutiny.
installation_requirements: Full surgical amputation or pre-existing amputation; military-grade neural socket; certified Arcturus installation technician
rejection_risk: Moderate — aggressive titanium mount profile irritates periosteal tissue without proper biocompatible liner
maintenance: Monthly hydraulic fluid check; blade housing lubrication every 6 weeks; firmware update via Arcturus secure uplink
